stem: What is the most likely reason the poet refers to the tree as a “tower” in lines 18 and 29 of the poem “Maple Street”?

options.label: F
options.text: To suggest the age of the tree that the speaker climbs

options.label: G
options.text: To highlight what objects the speaker enjoys sketching

options.label: H
options.text: To reveal the location of the tree in the speaker’s neighborhood

options.label: J
options.text: To emphasize the height from which the speaker observes the neighborhood
